title: A2UI Designer extension catalog
description: Opt-in components that A2UI Designer adds on top of the A2UI Basic catalog: a full-bleed image card and an icon drawn from an image URL or inline SVG. Mix with the Basic catalog per the A2UI 1.0 mixed-catalog rules: every instance sets "catalogId" to this catalog's id.
instructions:
These components come from the A2UI Designer extension catalog. Every instance MUST carry "catalogId": "https://posttool.github.io/a2ui-designer/catalogs/extensions/v1/catalog.json" on the component object (the surface default stays the Basic catalog).

- HeroCard: a card whose background is a full-bleed image (photo, artwork, map) with the content of its single `child` laid over it. Use it for hero/header moments where the image IS the visual (weather conditions, destinations, events, media). Set `scrim` so text stays legible: `auto` (default) picks a dark or light gradient from the image, `dark`/`light` force one, `none` only when the image itself is already calm behind the text. `fit` is `cover` (default, crops to fill) or `contain`. Put a Column with Text in `child`; keep overlaid copy short. Do not use a HeroCard just to show a picture — use Image for that.
- SvgIcon: a small icon drawn from an image `url` (SVG/PNG) or inline `svg` markup, for brand marks or glyphs the Basic Icon name list does not have. Set exactly one of `url` or `svg`. `size` is the edge length in px (12-96, default 20). Prefer the Basic Icon component whenever one of its names fits. Always set `accessibility.label` unless the icon is purely decorative next to a text label.

Example:
```json
{"id": "hero", "component": "HeroCard", "catalogId": "https://posttool.github.io/a2ui-designer/catalogs/extensions/v1/catalog.json", "image": {"@path": "/city/photo"}, "scrim": "auto", "child": "heroText"}
{"id": "brand", "component": "SvgIcon", "catalogId": "https://posttool.github.io/a2ui-designer/catalogs/extensions/v1/catalog.json", "url": "https://example.com/logo.svg", "size": 24, "accessibility": {"label": "Acme"}}
```

HeroCard.description: A card with a full-bleed background image and a single child laid over it, with an optional legibility scrim.

child.description: The ID of the single child component rendered on top of the image. To display multiple elements, wrap them in a Column or Row and pass that container's ID.

image.description: The URL of the background image.

scrim.description: Legibility overlay between the image and the child. 'auto' picks a dark or light gradient from the image; 'none' disables it.

fit.description: How the image fills the card, like CSS 'object-fit'.

weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column. This is similar to the CSS 'flex-grow' property. Note: this may ONLY be set when the component is a direct descendant of a Row or Column.

SvgIcon.description: An icon drawn from an image URL or from inline SVG markup (sanitized by the renderer). Exactly one of 'url' or 'svg' must be set.

url.description: The URL of an SVG or raster icon image.

svg.description: Inline SVG markup (a single <svg> element). Scripts, event handlers, external references and foreignObject are stripped.

size.description: Edge length of the icon in CSS pixels.

weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column. This is similar to the CSS 'flex-grow' property. Note: this may ONLY be set when the component is a direct descendant of a Row or Column.
